export.title: Download my data
export.body: A ZIP of everything you have entered here, as four files you can open in any spreadsheet. We build it in the background, so this can take a moment on a long history.
export.queued: Queued — we have your request and nothing has been built yet.
export.readyBody: {count} entries went in, {deleted} of them from the bin.
export.failed: That archive could not be built. Nothing has changed — try again.
export.linkSpent: That link has been used. Ask for a new one whenever you need it again.
export.expires: The link works once, and stops working {hours} hours after it is handed out.
export.oneTime: The archive never leaves this device on its own — we never email it, upload it, or keep a second copy anywhere.
export.filesNote: The amounts are exactly as they are stored, unconverted.
export.currencyNote: Every amount is in {code}, the currency your ledger is kept in — not the currency the app was showing. Nothing in the file has been converted.
export.neverRun: You have not asked for an archive yet.
export.errorBuildFailed: The archive could not be built. Try again in a moment.
export.errorExpired: That archive has been cleaned up. Ask for a new one.
export.errorInterrupted: That archive was interrupted and never finished. Ask for a new one.
del.title: Delete my account
del.body: This is permanent, so it asks for your password and then waits a week. Nothing is removed during those seven days, and you can change your mind at any point before the end of them.
del.passwordHelp: Type it again so we know it is really you.
del.reasonHelp: Optional. It is kept with the request and not used for anything else.
del.dangerTitle: Last chance to change your mind
del.confirmBody: In {days} days your account closes. Your entries, categories, budgets, wishlist, recurring entries and wallets are deleted then. Any group you are in keeps its books, and you stay in it as a former member so the other balances do not move.
del.pendingBody: That is {days} days from now. Nothing has been deleted yet.
del.pendingNote: Asking again will not move the date, and the seven days do not start over. Cancelling clears it completely and changes nothing else.
del.keeping: Good — your account stays exactly as it is.
del.scheduled: Your account closes on {date}. You can cancel it any time before then.
del.formerMemberNote: A group you were in keeps its bills, settlements and journal exactly as they are, and your row in the members list is kept so every other balance stays the same. Your name and email are removed from that row.
